intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Chaska for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events across Chaska and Waconia, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Northern Lights at the Minnesota Landscape Arboretum) through January 3, 2027 (Northern Lights), with the Waconia Tree Lighting (November 27), Santa Visits the Chaska Community Center (December 4) and Hometown Holiday (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Chaska

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Chaska, including 2 from Waconia and 2 moved from Minneapolis
  • 1 free event confirmed, Hometown Holiday on December 5; Spirit of Winter is $10 ages 3 and up and Northern Lights is $25 members and $35 nonmembers with children through age 15 free with ticket
  • Meet Santa: Santa Visits the Chaska Community Center and the Waconia Tree Lighting
  • Lights: Spirit of Winter at Sovereign Estate and Northern Lights at the Arboretum
  • Season: November 20 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Chaska families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Holly Trolley, the Christkindl market and the Children's Theatre.
